svg.aria-label: From a map of situations to a verdict a pull request can gate on
svg.title: From a map of situations to a verdict a pull request can gate on
svg.desc: 1. Map: What the agent can face: stages, values, tools, rules. A person approves it. 2. Tests: Code writes blocks from the map. A gate rejects tests that cannot fail. 3. Run: One adapter reaches your agent. Three run modes, repeats, record and replay. 4. Checks: 29 machine checks read the reply, the tool calls, the files. A fail is final. 5. Judges: A model judges the rest, quoting its evidence. A panel votes when unsure. 6. Statistics: An interval on every rate, the noise floor, paired tests between two runs. 7. Verdict: A scorecard, and an exit code CI can gate on: parity or regression.

text.font-family: 'Libre Caslon Text', 'Libre Caslon Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: From a map to a verdict.
